name: Chicken and Veg Traybake
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Chop the potatoes, carrots and onion into chunks and tip into a large roasting tin.
Toss with half the oil and the herbs, season, and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken thighs and chopped courgette, drizzle with the rest of the oil and roast for 30 minutes more, until the chicken is cooked through with no pink.
Divide between two plates and serve.
